title: Ledger Preview: Option to Include All Accounting Dimensions

posts.name: Abdus Samad
posts.cooked:
Hi everyone,

I submitted a PR to improve the Accounting Ledger Preview behavior so that configured Accounting Dimensions can optionally be included in the preview.

Issue: Accounting Ledger Preview does not show configured Accounting Dimensions #53405

PR: Feat-include-dimensions-in-accounting-preview #53217

Currently, the preview only shows the Cost Center field even when other Accounting Dimensions are configured.

This PR introduces a checkbox in Account Settings – “Include Dimensions In Preview” which allows showing all configured Accounting Dimensions in the ledger preview.

Would appreciate any feedback or review from the community or maintainers.

Thanks!
